---
name: Studio hardware observation
about: Document a specific revision, a stock behaviour or a component
title: "[Hardware] "
---

### Model and revision

Printed model, FCC ID, board marking if already visible, and stock software version if normally available. Remove serial numbers, QR codes and MAC addresses.

### Observation and conditions

Describe what happened and how often. Include relevant test conditions and the expected behaviour. Indicate whether you observed it on your unit, found it in public documentation or inferred it.

### Public evidence and limits

Link to datasheets or publications. If you have permission to share a photo, crop or redact identifiers. Summarise logs in your own words and exclude credentials, full firmware images and personal audio.
